annotations.title: What changed for a company since a date

description: For one tracked company, every new item from LIVE sources with its source time on or after `since`, newest first, counted by source, plus the sources that were not LIVE (not checked: no change from them is not evidence of none). Items are stored records, unchanged, each with its primary document link. Without a key this call costs $0.002 in USDC per call via x402 (send the payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]); a Seraphix Feed key covers it within its quota.

company.description: A tracked company: SEC CIK (leading zeros optional) or slug, e.g. "1692819" or "vistra".

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, to continue the same query.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Records compare by publication_date (whole UTC day); filings-wire items by SEC acceptance time.

name: what_changed_since

cite.description: Cite this: the attribution line for this response (CC BY 4.0). Records: cite each by its record_url.
